notes.title: Ashes of the Night reaches 50 Reviews
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone! Ashes of the Night is the first game I ever created and it's not without its flaws- but it's so wonderful to see it reach 50 reviews!

It was just the beginning for things here and I'm so grateful for everyone's support.

There have been many of you on the journey with me the entire  way and watched the games change and grow-- Ashes of the Night will always have a special place because of how well it did right out of the gate, the success it had ensured more games would be created.

As my good friend The Homelander says " You guys are the real heroes"

notes.title: Demon Scrolls has released
notes.notes:
Wayland is sent from the west to try and help the town of Vormon with their goblin problem.
Before he knows it he is wrapped up in a much larger conflict.
A powerful wizard called the Primagen is attempting to piece together ancient scrolls
to summon a demon into the world. Join Wayland in his journey to stop the Primagen,
before the world is doomed.

Demon Scrolls is not attempting to reinvent the wheel.
This is a classic story with classic gameplay.
The game is straight forward and easy to comprehend.
If you enjoy killing monsters and finding treasure then this game
could be a good fit for you.
Players can expect over 20 hours of gameplay.
(Single Player RPG)

notes.title: 7th Wolfs Moon Title Seventh Star Released
notes.notes:
The war of the wolves continues to wage on for decades as the North and South struggle for power.
A young female warrior named Quarry fights for the southern kingdom of Rinehart.
She attempts to unite the southern hemisphere while uncovering her past.
What will she discover about the Seventh Star as she digs deeper? The people need hope and perhaps Quarry is exactly the person
to bring them it.

Players will enjoy a vibrant soundtrack, massive variety of monsters to encounter, an enjoyable story and engaging combat.
The option for crafting & alchemy is available for players who enjoy it in Seventh Star.
Similar to other Wolfs Moon Studios titles- players can expect many hours of game play and appearances from old and familiar faces from previous stories.
Single player RPG.

*Hundreds of monster types
*Unique Crafting/Alchemy recipes
*Engaging combat with multiple elements/status effects
*Over 20 hours of gameplay

notes.title: Dungeon Crawler Daniel has Launched!
notes.notes:
Forsaken from his home...
Daniel must raise the money to buy it back from his ancestral birth givers.

Any adventurer that completes the Ravana Dungeon receives a massive pay out so Daniel goes on an adventure- but not before his parents cat Shana can hop in his backpack to tag along and annoy the everlasting heck out of Daniel.

Daniel & his familiar Shana must complete the dungeon to buy back his house!

Heroes from all timelines enter the fray
Join with them and descend the Ravana Dungeon.

Dungeon Crawler Daniel is a light hearted single-player RPG that has autosave & roguelike features where players can be removed by falling in combat.

There are A wide ensemble of monsters to face in the deepest levels of the dungeon.
Play any way that you wish....but in order to get the real gold you must complete the dungeon.

Average play time of 8-10 hours. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664010/Dungeon_Crawler_Daniel

notes.title: Verdungo coming August 31st
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378940/Verdungo

King Verdungo has been taken hostage and it's up to you to rescue him.
Travel across a diverse world to make your way back home, hopefully you arrive in time to save him before he meets an untimely demise.

Decide your party of four, choosing from classics such as Warrior, Cleric, Rogue, Paladin and Ninja- making up a total of 16 different playable classes.
In classic RPG fashion, players fight monsters, level up, and then are rewarded with points to spend to bolster the attributes of their characters.

Players will discover that gear can be crafted so you can create the ensemble that is just right for your play style.
Each class has their own set up of skills which make them unique, and skills will increase in power upon usage.

Along your journey to return home, players will encounter many NPC's which are in need of a heroes aid.
Different factions are at play and you never know if you're crossing paths with someone with ill intent or not!

It is up to you to decide who to help while making your journey back to rescue Verdungo.

* 15-20 hours of game play
* 75 different musical themes
* 150 different monster types throughout the world
* trade skills that can be utilized : Mining, Fishing, Crafting, Alchemy
* hundreds of crafting/alchemy recipes
* robust resource harvesting system that "regrows"
* open world where areas can be revisited (after tutorial)

notes.title: Next Chapter of Ashes of the Night, Wormskull April 10th Release
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153200/Wormskull/

Following in the wake of the much enjoyed RPG Ashes of the Night, Wormskull emerges as prequel of its predecessor.
Main Characters Duncan and Maduin take lead in this adventure, in constant haste with impending doom chasing them everywhere they go.
